row.evidence: Iterable's SSO Overview says "Iterable doesn't support System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) provisioning"; members can only be created by SAML just-in-time provisioning or by an org admin.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Quote-only pricing: iterable.com/pricing 301-redirects to the home page, and the Contact Sales page offers 'a pricing estimate', so team and SSO plan fields stay null. SAML SSO is documented with custom (non-gallery) SAML apps in Entra ID, Google Workspace and Okta; optional JIT provisioning creates members on first SAML login and a JSON 'roles' SAML attribute sets org permissions, projects and roles. Deprovisioning is by removing access in the IdP; no SCIM or API push exists. The public API manages marketing contacts, not Iterable members. No OIN or Entra gallery app found (okta.com/integrations/iterable/ and iterable-tutorial 404).

auth.notes: Api-Key header per the Swagger spec's securityDefinitions.

user_api.notes: The Iterable API's 'users' resource is marketing contacts (end customers), not Iterable org members. The full Swagger spec (138 paths) has no member, role or org endpoints, so team-member management via API is marked unavailable by absence.

okta.notes: Iterable's guide creates a custom SAML app in Okta; okta.com/integrations/iterable/ returned 404.

entra.notes: Non-gallery enterprise app per Iterable's guide; Microsoft Learn iterable-tutorial returned 404.

google.notes: Custom SAML app per Iterable's guide.

fallbacks.notes: JIT is optional; with it, the IdP is the source of truth for members and roles via the roles SAML attribute, applied at next login.
